Rajasthan Tensions Rise After Ex-BJP MLA's Death, RSS Worker's Alleged Assault

Tensions have risen in Rajasthan following the death of a former BJP MLA and an alleged assault on an RSS worker inside a police station. Reports indicate the RSS worker was stripped and beaten. An MLA stated that a case of attempted murder should be filed against the police personnel involved. The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has reportedly questioned the Director General of Police regarding the incident.
